category_title: Students focused on task completion with accuracy and partially effective self-regulation
minimal_context: The student is working on a reading comprehension task during an individualized support session.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Let's start the reading comprehension task. Please read the passage and answer the questions at the end.

STUDENT: Okay. I'm trying to use the reading strategies we talked about. I asked myself, do I understand what the information is saying? But I'm not really sure if I'm doing it right.

TUTOR: Keep trying to read through it.

STUDENT: Can you help me? I want to make sure my answers are accurate so I can get a good grade and avoid failing, but I don't know how to find the right information.

TUTOR: Just do what you can.

STUDENT: Fine, I'll just write down whatever to finish the task. I'm not going to try to understand it anymore because everything …confusing.

options.A: Provide a wide variety of reading passages for free choice reading during the support sessions.
options.B: Ask follow-up questions during the reading comprehension task to model conversational skills for the student.
options.C: Emphasize mastery goals by highlighting the value of engagement for pursuing deep learning and improving knowledge.
options.D: Incorporate the student's interest in dump trucks and tractors into the reading comprehension passages.
